description_sq:
VILE NE SHITJE 
 Shitet vile 3 kateshe prane TEG me siperfaqe trualli 400m2 (sip ndertim 269 m2) me certifikate pronesie, 4 dhoma gjumi, 4 Tualete, 1 ballkon 
 • Kati perdhe organizohet dhome ndenje, kuzhine dhe tualet 
 • Kati dyte organizohet ne dhome gjumi me tualet dhe ballkon, 2 dhoma te tjera gjumi dhe nje tualet 
 • Kati 3-te/papafingo organizohet ne 1 dhome gjumi me tualet dhe nje dhome boshe qe mund te pershtatet si dhome gjumi 
 *Vila eshte totalisht e investuar nga pronari me arredim modern. Vila eshte e pabanuar asnjehere me pare. 
 *Vila eshte ideale per banim pasi ndodhet ne nje zone te qete dhe me ajer te paster . Mund te jete mundesi shume e mire edhe per investim afatgjate. 
 Cmimi i shitjes 695.000 euro
description_en: VILLA FOR SALE 3-storey villa for sale near TEG with a plot area of 400m2 (as construction 269 m2) with certificate of ownership, 4 bedrooms, 4 toilets, 1 balcony • The ground floor is organized as a living room, kitchen and toilet • The second floor is organized as a bedroom with a toilet and a balcony, 2 other bedrooms and a toilet • The 3rd floor/attic is organized as 1 bedroom with toilet and an empty room that can be adapted as a bedroom *The villa is fully invested by the owner with modern furnishings. The villa has never been inhabited before. *The villa is ideal for living as it is located in a quiet area with clean air. It can be a very good opportunity for long-term investment. Selling price 695,000 euros
